profile.name: Xakios
profile.title: Cursed Root of the World Tree
profile.characteristics: [Strike of the Giant Beast] deals massive DMG to knocked over enemies. Clear the knocked over state of [Giant Earthquake] or use heroes with [CC Resistance] skills are advantageous in this stage.

1.name: Strike of the Giant Beast
1.description: Deals P.DMG to frontal enemies. If they were knocked over when hit, deals even greater P.DMG.

2.name: Giant Earthquake
2.description: Strikes the ground 3 times, dealing P.DMG to all enemies. The last hit knocks all enemies over for 8 sec.

3.name: Acid Breath
3.description: Gathers energy and exhales an acid breath that deals M.DMG to all enemies and reduces M.DEF.

4.name: Purify
4.description: Every 30 sec, remove all negative effects and increase ATK Spd.
